'''Nikolai Danilovich Morozkin'''  ({{langx|ru|Николай Данилович Морозкин}}; born 27 November 1953) is a Soviet and Russian [[mathematician]]. [[Doctor of Sciences|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (1996), [[Professor]] (1997), Rector of [[Bashkir State University]] (since 2013), Honorary Figure of Higher Education of the Russian Federation (2011).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Справочно-информационный ресурс "Кто есть кто в республике Башкортостан"|url=http://personarb.ru/index.php?categoryid=15&nomer=958031|access-date=2021-11-15|website=personarb.ru}}</ref>

==Life==
Nikolai Morozkin graduated from [[Mordovian State University|Mordovia State University]] in 1975. In 1980 he finished his postgraduate studies at the Faculty of Applied Mathematics in [[Saint Petersburg State University|Leningrad State University]]. In 1980–1983 he worked as a senior lecturer for the Department of Differential Equations in Mordovia State University.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Morozkin Nikolai Danilovich|url=http://bulletin-bsu.com/en/morozkin-n-d/|access-date=2021-11-15|language=ru-RU}}</ref>

In 1983 he started to teach at [[Bashkir State University]], first as a senior lecturer, docent. In 1993 he became the Head of the Department of Applied Informatics and Numerical Methods, and since 1997 he simultaneously worked as a vice-rector for academic affairs.<ref name=":0" />

On May 16, 2021, Nikolai Morozkin was elected Rector of Bashkir State University.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ректором Башкирского государственного университета избран профессор Н.Д. Морозкин|url=https://cheboksari.bezformata.com/listnews/gosudarstvennogo-universiteta/11559149/|access-date=2021-11-15|website=cheboksari.bezformata.com}}</ref> In October 2017, he was elected again for the next period. Nikolai Morozkin is a member of The Board of Trustees of Bashkir Regional Branch of [[The Russian Geographical Society Glacier|The Russian Geographical Society]].

==Research==

In 1980, he defended his Candidate's dissertation; in 1996 – his Doctorate dissertation. In 1997, he became a professor.

Areas of research:
* [[Mathematical model|Mathematical Modelling]],
* [[Informatics]],
* Control Optimization,
* [[Numerical Methods Development]].

Nikolai Morozkin created problem-solving procedures for speed-in-action problems with non-linear convex phase constraints and for heat optimizations problems accounting for various technological constraints and strength properties of heated objects. He conducted research in mathematical modeling and calculation of pressure field in medical and biological systems, for example, in в temporomandibular joint.<ref name=":0" />

Nikolai Morozkin is a member of Doctorate Dissertation Defence Boards for the following specialties: thermophysics and thermology; fluid, gas, and plasma mechanics. He is an author of about 100 scientific papers, 2 utility patents.<ref name=":0" />
